title: The Hospital That Washed Organs in Dishwashers
hook: A major hospital chain saved money by cleaning surgical instruments in dishwashers, leading to patient deaths and a cover-up that lasted years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines gross-out shock with institutional betrayal—a potent mix for outrage-driven shares.

title: The 'Vitamin' That Was Radioactive Uranium
hook: In the 1920s, a company sold 'energy-boosting' radioactive water. People drank it for years before their jaws literally fell off.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror meets historical ignorance—viewers will be horrified and fascinated.

title: The Hospital That Harvested Teeth from Dead Babies
hook: A pathology lab stole thousands of teeth from deceased infants and sold them to researchers—without parental knowledge or consent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Violation of dead infants is an unspeakable taboo—viewers will click in horrified disbelief.

title: The Government That Made 'Fluoride' from Chemical Weapons Waste
